entries.7a27f5ff6a7ca307: The company has formulated a medium-term management plan covering fiscal 2026-2028 and, under the slogan “Passing On Strength, Toward the Future: Building Foundations Toward 220 Years Since Founding,” states that it will promote four reforms across the whole company: “how we organize, products, how we sell, and how we think.” It states that it has organized its business portfolio into four categories of growth, stable, improvement and restructuring, will review unprofitable structures and conventional business models, and aims to establish a stable profit-generating structure.
